finding: The proposed redaction crosswalk contained unsalted hashes of 140 distinct removed local path values in alias rows and 596 edit rows. These fingerprints can support candidate matching.
action: A separately named successor without individual path-value digests is being prepared and must be reviewed and scanned before publication.
qualification: Whole-file identities here are not hashes of individual path values. The predecessor and original evidence remain separately held; this record does not claim independent custody or global privacy.
